title: objects of power, capricorn iii
content:
this series is created for my collaboration with LJ of Ceremony for their communal writing practice, Atmospheres, based of the 36 decans of the astrological year.

Capricorn II — January 13-21
Key themes from LJ — keys, secrets, compartments
Before this: Capricorn II, visioning cathedrals

*

Capricorn III is full of deeply symbolic fairytale objects — the crown, the keys, the vault, each of which carry the weight of some significant threshold passage.

  • crown — ascension to the throne, claiming soveriegnty

  • keys — exclusivity, access, possession, ownership of something

  • vault — the place where our secrets, desires, and precious things are stored.

since being immersed in Atmospheres, I’ve found myself returning to symbolic objects (like artifacts) as ways to investigate the dark corners of my psyche, my imagination, and unconscious landscape.

  • when I close my eyes and imagine my crown, I am reminding myself to claim sovereignty over my own life — even when it feels like there are so few things that I can truly control. sovereignty is not the same thing as control. it is about staying in your power — even when confronted with chaos — and responding to it from a grounded place.

  • there are so many keys in my universe — each creative practice sometimes feels like a secret compartment, with its own keys. when I’m obsessed with a project, a dilemma, a big life question, I think about what the key is — what would unlock the next door for me? not all the doors. just the next one.

  • a vault is where I keep things safe and sealed — not just from the world, but also from myself, because I am aware of my worst — and best — tendencies. a vault is a container for being completely contained. when I feel too porous and fragile, it helps to create rhythm practices that, themselves, feel like a vault. a submarine is a vault. I put some tender part of myself in my vault, knowing that sometimes, what it needs is not light and air, but silence, and darkness. to gather power in the dark. and — the next time I look at it, it’ll already have transformed.

as a scorpio, I’ve appreciated how Capricorn III feels heavy and serious, but with a romantic magical depth of fairytales — like looking treasures inside a buried mountain cave. these are my objects of power. I’ll return to it in my imagination and see what other pathways they open for me.
